questions.question: Define food adulteration.
questions.solution_html:
• Define food adulteration. (2 marks)
  • ● Food adulteration is the intentional or unintentional addition of inferior or harmful
  • substances to food or removal of valuable components. (1 mark)
  • ● It reduces food quality, safety, and nutritional value. (1 mark)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: List the three types of food hazards.
questions.solution_html:
• List the three types of food hazards. (2 marks)
  • ● Biological hazards – microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, fungi. (0.5)
  • ● Chemical hazards – pesticides, toxins, heavy metals. (0.5)
  • ● Physical hazards – foreign objects like glass, metal, stones. (0.5)
  • ● Correct listing of hazards. (0.5)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.solution_html:

  • Comparison
  • ● Fructose – sweetest (2)
  • ● Sucrose – reference sugar (2)
  • ● Glucose – moderately sweet (1.5)
  • ● Maltose – least sweet (1.5)
